Print.description: Write a diagnostic message to the control's console and status line.

LoginMessage.description: Show a message under the sign-in button: 1 = invalid username or password, 2 = badly formatted username, any other value clears it. duration greater than zero fades the message away after that many milliseconds.

RegisterMessage.description: Show a message under the sign-up button: 3 = username already exists, any other value clears it. duration greater than zero fades the message away after that many milliseconds.

UpdateRecipeList.description: Replace the displayed recipes with a JSON array string.

ShowPage.description: Jump to the given 1-based page of the recipe list.

onPressOnItem.description: An operator pressed a recipe item; gives the index within the full list.

onPressNewRecipe.description: An operator pressed the New Recipe button.

onSignIn.description: An operator pressed Sign in; JSON string of {username, password}.

onSignUp.description: An operator pressed Sign up; JSON string of {username, password}.
